g.text: Scoped document retrieval — UML sequence view
Child environment allowlist: LC_ALL, PYTHONPATH, SEARCH_BACKEND;
optional SEARCH_UNLIMITED_TEXT. Qdrant mode also forwards supplied
validate retrieval capability, policy, and plan
approved ResourceBindings and exact versions -> resource_keys
POST prefixed query to configured EMBEDDING_URL
metadata.source_scope or metadata.resource_key in scope keys)
validate document fields, count, and scope again
bound response text for local Lead profile
A direct MCP caller may supply an empty scope. SearchBackend then returns
SearchResponse(documents=[]) before embedding or querying either backend.
Plan authorization rejects empty scopes in the orchestration path above.
